title: Iron ore tube vein in a boat pit

tellings.quote: So here I'm down inside of one of these {quote} {unquote} boat pits. Mhm. And this is an image This is a tube.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum says that inside one of the so-called boat pits on the Giza Plateau in Egypt, cut-out pits beside the pyramids, there is a tube-shaped vein of iron ore. Drum says he went down into the pit himself and shows an image of what he calls "a tube." He brings it up as part of his claim that an energy grid lies beneath the pyramids.
